lines.text: Saul keeps two thousand men at Michmash while Jonathan leads a thousand and attacks the Philistine outpost at Gibeon.
The people are summoned to Saul at Gilgal, and the Philistines camp at Michmash while Israel's men hide in caves.
After Saul waits seven days for Samuel and his troops begin to desert, he offers the burnt offering.
Samuel tells Saul his kingdom will not endure, then goes up to Gibeah, and Saul counts about two thousand men.
Raiders leave the Philistine camp in three divisions, and only Saul and Jonathan have a sword or spear.
